translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content: Kuom jatend wer. Zaburi mar Daudi.

content.text: Ngʼama paro joma ok nyal en jahawi;
Jehova Nyasaye rese ka chandruok omake.
Jehova Nyasaye biro rite kendo biro miyo obed mangima;
Jehova Nyasaye biro gwedhe e piny,
kendo ok obi jwangʼe e lwet wasike.
Jehova Nyasaye biro rite e kitandane mar tuo midekre
kendo obiro miyo oa malo e kitandane ka ohewore.
Ne awacho niya, “Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, kecha;
changa, nikech aseketho e nyimi.”
Wasika wuoyo kuoma ka chunygi rach koda, kagiwacho niya,
“Obiro tho karangʼo mondo nyinge olal chuth?”
Sa asaya ma ngʼato obiro nena,
to owuondore ni owuoyo kuoma maber,
to ei chunye to ofwambo weche,
mondo okethgo nyinga eka oa odhi kendo okeyo wechego ne ji.
Wasika duto kuodho wach kuoma kaachiel kaka ginyalo hinya,
chunygi paro gik maricho mogik mondo ohinya,
kagiwacho niya,
“Tuo marach osekete piny;
ok obi aa malo kama oninde.”
Koda ka osiepna mane ageno kuome,
ngʼat mane chiemo koda,
bende osendhoga.
To in, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, yie ikecha;
chunga malo, mondo achulgi.
Angʼeyo ni chunyi mor koda,
nimar jowasika ok loya.
Itingʼa malo nikech timna makare
kendo ichunga e nyimi nyaka chiengʼ.
Pak ne Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel,
nyaka chiengʼ kendo nyaka chiengʼ.
